2843-6553-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3585-5627-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
3585-5627-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

132-5090-7826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Foods.

7-751-1741-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control at least 2 creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-751-1741-5778.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries with offspring by paying {1}{U} using the cost reduction from Hamza.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries abilities, untapping two lands.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When the token copy of Cloud of Faeries enters, its ability triggers, untapping two lands.
Activate four lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake with offspring by paying {U}, using cost reduction from Hamza.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries to its owner's hand.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Shrieking Drake.
When the token copy of Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers, returning the nontoken Shrieking Drake to its owner's hand.
Repeat.
7-751-1741-5778.notes: Once infinite mana has been generated, the Shrieking Drake can return any creature other than Zinnia to hand to recast infinitely.

261-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

792-997-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
792-997-2946-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-2921-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2438-3991-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-3025-4681-5170.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4771-4908-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-2279-5220-6441-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-5220-6441-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

628-3108-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.
628-3108-5686.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

317-874-5660.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
317-874-5660.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Delif's Cone ability.
Repeat.

1274-2685-4186-4321.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2685-4186-4321.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2523-2869.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-2523-2869.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

513-527-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

1018-2593-4067-6281.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

372-3991-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Faceless Butcher
372-3991-4200.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Faceless Butcher.
Faceless Butcher leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering Faceless Butcher's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Faceless Butcher trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

710-1258-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

277-1170-1418-1645-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1738-2939-3533.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Doomgape triggers, causing you to sacrifice Serra Avatar and gain life equal to its toughness.
Defiant Bloodlord triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

5026-5959.manaNeeded: {R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
5026-5959.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
5026-5959.description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Reverberate, with the copy targeting the original Reverberate.
Resolve the copy of Reverberate, copying the original Reverberate, with the copy targeting the original Reverberate.
Repeat step 5.

4881-5011-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cavalier of Night, adding {R}.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding {R}.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat from step 5.

352-1912-4539.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
352-1912-4539.description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating two Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

787-1170-2369-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to put Sensei's Divining Top into your hand.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Repeat.
You may tap additional mana-producing permanents in step 3, and untap them in step 4, to get a large amount of mana.

1315-1532-1721.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can enter the battlefield untapped and tap to produce at least {9}{W}.
1315-1532-1721.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {9}{W}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Cast Faith's Reward by paying {3}{W}, returning all permanents that were put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Faith's Reward from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
